utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Before we start with the present witness I have a few procedural matters. We can deal with it rather quickly. First of all, the parties inquired why we would not be sitting on the 23rd of July. We had to give up the courtroom for the start of the Perisic trial but since now it appears that that trial has been -- the start of the trial has been delayed, there's no reason not to sit on the 23rd. So, therefore, the court schedule will be adapted accordingly. But I should have started by asking Madam Registrar to call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon Your Honour, good afternoon, everyone, this is case number IT-06-90-T, The Prosecutor versus Ante Gotovina et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. Then we have two minor things. First, D49, I do understand that the revised translation has been uploaded by the Cermak Defence in e-court and there are no objections by the Prosecution against this translation.

utterances.speaker: MR. MARGETTS
utterances.text: No, Your Honour, that is acceptable to us.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, could you please inform the Court about what the status at present is of D49.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I am informed that a translation is there but has not yet been uploaded into e-court, so we'll -- it was admitted as an exhibit waiting for this translation. So, therefore, the status remains unchanged. That means admitted into evidence but the Cermak Defence is invited to upload the translation as soon as possible. Then we had a similar issue for P503 where there was some translation problems. The parties, as I understand, have agreed that the original translation is an accurate translation. That is the notebook of a person, I think, that will still be called to testify.

utterances.speaker: MR. MARGETTS
utterances.text: No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MARGETTS
utterances.text: He is not listed as a witness for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: So therefore I can say that it is the notebook of Mr. Zvonko Gambiroza. Madam Registrar, the status of P503 was ... was already admitted and now with the agreement of the parties there is no issue about that anymore. We have received the -- several documents listing documents that were tendered from the bar table. We'll first have a look at it before we finally decide on the matter. Then, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MARGETTS
utterances.text: Your Honour, if we're dealing with the admission of some documents, there's two other documents --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, it is functioning again. It reminds us how important it is to have a transcript and how much we rely on the accuracy, the usual accuracy of the transcript. Then before -- yes, Mr. Margetts.

utterances.speaker: MR. MARGETTS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, there were two other documents that the parties were in discussions about and that was 65 ter 5259. This document was a 16 August report from Dr. Brkic to Ante Gotovina and the parties have agreed for that document to be admitted. And there was a second document which was P507. The Defence have presented another version of P507, which is identical in its terms although it is a different copy of the same document and it has an annex to it and we agreed to the admission of that and that currently has 65 ter 5286. And although it's the same document, it is a different copy of the document with the annex, so it may be appropriate either for it to be given an exhibit number, P507.1 or, alternatively, an entirely different exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Do we need to keep the one that was uploaded or --

utterances.speaker: MR. MARGETTS
utterances.text: The only reason is that the witness has refer to the one that was uploaded although he didn't recognise the document and there was no significance in that original version, so maybe we could show him a new version and that would resolve that issue.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, I leave that to the parties whether they want to show a new version of it. Madam Registrar, has 65 ter 5259 already an exhibit number? That is the Brkic report. Then, Madam Registrar, would you please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, 65 ter 05259 will be Exhibit P543. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, may I take it on the basis of what we heard that there's no objection against P543 and P543 is admitted in evidence and we leave P507 open for the -- or Madam Registrar, could the new version receive a dot one number? It would mean P507.1.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: 65 ter 05286 will become Exhibit P507.1.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Then I take it there is no objection against the admission of that document. P507.1 is admitted into evidence and I leave to the parties whether or not P507.1 should be shown to the witness. Then before we start, Witness P-086, I'd like to remind you that you are still by the solemn declaration that you gave at the beginning of your testimony. We now move into private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we're in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. Witness P-086, I would like to remind you -- I would like to instruct you again that you should not speak with anyone about your testimony either already given or still to be given. We will adjourn until tomorrow, the 4th of July, at 9.00 in this same courtroom, and, of course, we'll hope that we will be able to conclude your testimony tomorrow. We stand adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 4th of July, 2008, at 9.00 a.m. 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 6.59 p.m.,
